# Draft: allocation proposal for Mateo (as of 2026-11-12)

## Short answer
No governance check blocked either mix. Both got a **WARN**.

**Your current mix** (FTS.TO 20%, XBB.TO 50%, RY.TO 30%) breaks the single-position limit. RY.TO is 30% against a 10% limit (ev-02ab1af65d).

**The optimizer's smallest compliant adjustment** is XBB.TO ~80%, FTS.TO ~10% and RY.TO ~10% (ev-d5d44f549b, ev-37b93ab0b3). This fixes the single-position breach. FTS.TO and RY.TO each sit at 9.98% against the 10% cap (ev-e54e6b5a19).

The new mix is a heavy **stability tilt**. It is not a balanced growth/stability mix. The optimizer added no growth candidate, so equity is only about 20% of the portfolio (ev-37b93ab0b3). If you want more growth, you would need to add diversified equity holdings. That is a separate step I haven't analysed or checked.

## Controversy screen
- No verified major controversies were found for FTS.TO or RY.TO as of 2026-11-12 (ev-efb349d3f0).
- This is **not a full clearance**. The governance check marks the controversy exclusion as UNVERIFIED because there is no verified data row for FTS.TO or RY.TO (ev-e54e6b5a19). Controversies inside the bond ETF are not modelled, and XBB.TO was neither flagged nor cleared (ev-efb349d3f0).
- FTS.TO is absent from the reference ESG index (MSCI Canada IMI Extended ESG Leaders, XCSR), and the reason is not published (ev-efb349d3f0, ev-e54e6b5a19). This is a preference signal to discuss, not a ban. It is the source of the WARN on the proposed mix. RY.TO is in the ESG Focus index (ev-efb349d3f0).

## Key figures
| Item | Current mix | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Annual volatility | 7.3% | ev-f646a0844d |
| RY.TO share of portfolio risk | 46.6% (on 30% of the weight) | ev-f646a0844d |
| Effective number of positions | 2.63 of 3 | ev-3ef8977498 |

- The simulation covers the **current** mix only. It is not a forecast and is before fees. I have no equivalent figures for the proposed 80/10/10 mix, so I don't quote any.
- Correlations between the holdings are low, but they tend to rise in market falls (ev-0128115ea7).

## Limitations
- Governance also lists missing information on loss capacity (ev-e54e6b5a19).
- The ESG data's load date (2026-11-15) is after the requested as_of date (2026-11-12). This should be noted (ev-efb349d3f0).
- Past performance does not predict future results.
- This is a fictional educational simulation, not personalized financial advice.
